newsitem.title: PERU: Peru rescuers say find survivors from plane crash.
newsitem.headline: Peru rescuers say find survivors from plane crash.

text.p: Rescue workers said "some" survivors had been identified from the crash early on Wednesday of an AeroPeru jet in the Pacific Ocean off Peru.
"The rescue workers on the scene have given us information of survivors," fire department spokeswoman Milagros Cuba told Reuters.
Earlier, the fire department had said all 200 people on board the jet died when it crashed after reporting an emergency at 1:34 a.m. (0634 GMT.)
Cuba could not say how many were believed to have survived the accident.
She added that rescuers had placed lights on the coast to guide survivors in from the sea, and nearby hospitals were readying to receive victims.

An AeroPeru spokesman said there were "problems" with its jet number 603, but would not confirm the death-toll or give details on the nationality of passengers. "We will be giving a press conference later," he said.
